title: Alƙawarin Ba a Haife Ba
intro: Mutum mai gaskiya ya yi alkawari mai tsarki kafin zuwan yaro. Labarin wannan mutum yana bayyana a cikin ganuwar wani wuri mai tsarki, inda ibada ke haɗuwa da karɓuwa daga Allah. Wanene wannan bawan Allah?
clues: Na kasance cikin iyali mai daraja a cikin Alqur'ani.
Na yi alƙawarin sadaukar da ɗana da ke cikina ga bautar Allah.
Da na haihu, na yi mamakin ganin cewa 'ya mace ce, duk da cewa na yi tsammanin ɗa.
Na sanya wa ɗana suna Maryamu, suna da ke nuna ibada da hidima.
Na nemi tsarin Allah ga ɗana da zuriyarta daga Shaidan la'ananne.
Ubangiji ya karɓe yarona kuma ya sanya shi ƙarƙashin kulawar Annabi Zakariyya a cikin wurin ibada.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Tana alƙawarin sadaukar da ɗanta ga haikali
Ketare teku a kan busasshiyar ƙasa
trial.answer: Tana alƙawarin sadaukar da ɗanta ga haikali

options: Wurin ibada (mihrab) inda aka sanya ɗanta
Dabino da ta kwanta a ƙarƙashinsa
location.answer: Wurin ibada (mihrab) inda aka sanya ɗanta

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An karɓi ɗanta aka sanya shi ƙarƙashin kulawar Annabi Zakariyya.
An cece ta daga hukuncin azzalumi
An ba ta ɗa mai suna Yahya
Ta zama sarauniya a kan wata babbar masarauta
outcome.answer: An karɓi ɗanta aka sanya shi ƙarƙashin kulawar Annabi Zakariyya.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
